user_notifications_content_check.name: user_notifications_content_check
user_notifications_content_check.value: ("user_notifications"."deleted_at" is null and "user_notifications"."params" is not null) or ("user_notifications"."deleted_at" is not null and "user_notifications"."params" is null and "user_notifications"."read_at" is null)

user_plan_state_plan_check.name: user_plan_state_plan_check
user_plan_state_plan_check.value:
"user_plan_state"."plan" in ('gratis', 'pro', 'agen')
				and ("user_plan_state"."billing_period" is null or "user_plan_state"."billing_period" in ('weekly', 'monthly'))
				and ("user_plan_state"."plan" = 'gratis' or "user_plan_state"."current_period_end" is not null)

vouchers_content_check.name: vouchers_content_check
vouchers_content_check.value:
"vouchers"."max_redemptions" >= 1 and "vouchers"."redemption_count" between 0 and "vouchers"."max_redemptions"
				and (("vouchers"."kind" = 'credits' and "vouchers"."credits_amount" between 1 and 1000000000
						and "vouchers"."plan" is null and "vouchers"."plan_days" is null)
					or ("vouchers"."kind" = 'plan_days' and "vouchers"."credits_amount" is null and "vouchers"."plan" in ('pro', 'agen')
						and "vouchers"."plan_days" between 1 and 366))

wallets_last_four_check.name: wallets_last_four_check
wallets_last_four_check.value: "wallets"."last_four" is null or (length("wallets"."last_four") = 4 and "wallets"."last_four" not glob '*[^0-9]*')
